criteria: randomized controlled trials, 2020 onwards, human, type 2 diabetes

source_review.title: Tirzepatide, a dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor co-agonist for the treatment of type 2 diabetes with unmatched effectiveness regrading glycaemic control and body weight reduction

conclusion_summary: GLP-1 receptor agonists reduce major adverse cardiovascular events in patients with type 2 diabetes at elevated CV risk.
limitations: Mixed effects across specific MACE components
